# Maximum Difference Between Increasing Elements. -1 means no earlier
# number has a strictly larger one after it.

@example Choose 2 (position 1) and 11 (position 4): 11 - 2 = 9.
[6,2,9,3,11,5]
=> 9

@example No number has a strictly larger one after it, and equal numbers don't count.
[8,8,5,5,1]
=> -1

@example The largest number, 12, comes before the smallest, 1, so they can't be paired; 3 followed by 7 gains the most, 4.
[12,3,7,1,4]
=> 4
